findings.title: The live-demo success criterion is deferred rather than completed
findings.description: The slice’s success criterion 6 requires a non-SDK model dispatch to call `cf_build_context` and receive assembled context. Task 9.3 explicitly leaves walkthrough step 4 open, and no task implements or verifies that demo. As written, the breakdown does not cover all stated success criteria.

findings.title: The fake-server tests do not exercise a CF tool executor end to end
findings.description: Slice success criterion 3 calls for a real stdio round-trip in which an executor returns the fake server’s text; criterion 4 requires spawn failure not to escape the executor. Task 5 tests `call_mcp_tool` directly, while Task 7 mocks that transport for descriptor tests. The live executor round-trip in Task 8 uses the real CF server and may be skipped when unavailable, so it does not fill this gap. Add a test that invokes a materialized CF executor against the fake server, including the executor-level failure path.

findings.title: Some required result and transport behaviors lack test coverage
findings.description: The slice’s result-mapping rules require joining multiple text blocks and noting non-text blocks by type, but the fake server and bridge tests cover only a single text response, an error response, and an empty response. The design also lists protocol/transport errors as a failure mode whose observable warning should be tested; an unknown tool test does not establish handling of a closed stream or transport exception. Add targeted fixture cases and assertions for these behaviors.
